data.one_liner: Lightweight Dart package providing the Week class based on the ISO 8601 format.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Week class to handle ISO 8601 week-numbering years in Dart. Allows you to easily find the current week, navigate to previous or future weeks, retrieve dates within a week, and parse ISO week strings.
use_when: You need to work with ISO 8601 week numbers and date ranges in your Dart app.
You want to calculate previous or future weeks relative to a given date.
avoid_when: you need a full-featured date/time library with timezone handling and general datetime manipulation.
strengths: Simple and lightweight API specifically for ISO 8601 weeks.
Supports conversions from DateTime and ISO strings.
weaknesses: Very narrow scope, limited to week-based operations.
Does not handle general date formatting or timezones beyond local time.
